mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.15%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 1060.0) indicates weakening economic activity across supply and demand sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 AND HOUST < 1060.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1060.0) reflects weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1060.0.

mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining CPI (CPIAUCSL ≤ 238.0) indicates low inflationary pressure, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL ≤ 238.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 18000.0) during late-cycle expansion signals robust economic fundamentals, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 18000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 101.0) indicates weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 101.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising payroll count (PAYEMS > 142000.0) reflects strong labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 142000.0.
